verdicts.reason: Both have the same main flaw: the glow circle has slid left, away from the can, so the hero no longer sits in its halo and the headline runs over the circle's edge. Both also enlarge 'Swipe up to shop' into a mid-size line above the CTA, which competes with it. In A, the three badges (ONLINE ONLY, LIMITED RUN, NEW) are crammed together and nearly touching in the top-left, and the SOLSTICE logo is pushed off-axis to the right, so the header reads as cluttered and lopsided. B keeps the logo on the centre axis and groups the badges with the CTA as the original does, but the lower stack (subcopy, swipe line, badges, button) is jammed together while a big empty gap sits between the logo and the can.
